definitions.short: to select ; to feed ; to render clear
definitions.full: H1262. barah I. בָּרָה verb eat (Assyrian barû & derivatives Zim BP 31 ) — Qal Perfect 2Sam 12:17 ; Imperfect אֶבְרֶה 13:6 , 10 eat bread ( בְּרוּלְֿכֶם 1Sam 17:8 scribal error for לכם בחרו 1Kin 18:25 Dr Sm 107 ). Pi`el Infinitive לְבָרוֺת Lam 4:10 for devouring . Hiph`il Imperfect תַּבְרֵנִי 2Sam 13:5 ; Infinitive לְהַבְרוֺת 3:35 cause to eat bread .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from 1250 ) to feed; also (as equivalent to 1305 ) to render clear (Ecclesiastes 3:18)
